product_context.name: Maintenance Queue Fixture
product_context.purpose: Help facilities operators find the next work order and inspect its context before acting.

task: Help a facilities operator find urgent work, compare due dates, inspect the selected work order, and return to the queue without losing context.

workflow_steps: find or narrow a work order

existing_alternatives.name: Urgency-ranked queue with persistent inspector
existing_alternatives.composition: A searchable urgency-ranked list beside a persistent selected-order inspector.
existing_alternatives.hierarchy: Priority and due date lead the queue; selected-order context remains visible alongside it.
existing_alternatives.task_flow: Find and compare an order, inspect it, then return to the same queue state.
existing_alternatives.responsive_behavior: Stack the queue and inspector at narrow widths without discarding selection.
existing_alternatives.tradeoffs: Supports side-by-side urgency comparison; the inspector consumes horizontal room.

existing_alternatives.name: Status lanes with focused record view
existing_alternatives.composition: Three status lanes with a selected order replacing the board for full-width inspection.
existing_alternatives.hierarchy: Workflow status leads; urgency and due date are secondary within each lane.
existing_alternatives.task_flow: Choose a lane, inspect an order, then return to the board.
existing_alternatives.responsive_behavior: Allow lane navigation at narrow widths and keep selected details in reading order.
existing_alternatives.tradeoffs: Useful for stage dispatch; cross-status urgency comparison requires more navigation.
